note: This file is a MMDetection configuration dictionary only — no callable functions, classes, or CLI entry points. It defines hyperparameters for a Guided Anchoring RPN (GARPNHead) model using ResNet-50 FPN backbone on COCO with 1x schedule.
config_model: configure the GARPNHead model with approx and square anchor generators for guided anchoring RPN
config_train_cfg: configure the ApproxMaxIoUAssigner and RandomSampler training settings for guided anchoring RPN
config_loss_functions: configure FocalLoss, BoundedIoULoss, CrossEntropyLoss, and SmoothL1Loss for the GARPNHead model
config_anchor_generators: configure the AnchorGenerator with octave_base_scale 8 and ratios 0.5 1.0 2.0 for approx anchors
config_optim_wrapper: configure gradient clipping with max_norm 35 and L2 norm for the training optimizer
